results.name: Jardín del Turia (Turia Gardens)
results.principal_activities: Walking, cycling, jogging; passing through 18 historic bridges, Gulliver Park playground, Palau de la Música
results.why_it_is_special: A 9 km-long lush green corridor built in the former Turia riverbed — one of Spain's largest urban parks, threading through the heart of the city from Cabecera Park to the City of Arts and Sciences.

results.name: Jardín Botánico de Valencia (Botanical Garden)
results.locality: Valencia city centre (near Torres de Quart)
results.why_it_is_special: Houses over 5,000 plant species across six hectares in the heart of the city; one of Spain's most important botanical collections, with year-round educational activities for families.

results.name: Jardines de Monforte
results.why_it_is_special: A fairy-tale palatial garden with neatly trimmed hedges, ponds, statues, and intimate pathways — a hidden haven of peace in the middle of the city.

results.name: Jardines de Viveros (Jardines del Real)
results.why_it_is_special: Originally the royal gardens from the Arab period; today one of Valencia's biggest public gardens, featuring sculptures, geometric gardens, a pond, and flower-covered arches.

results.name: Malvarrosa Beach
results.principal_activities: Swimming, paddleboarding, surfing, windsurfing, kayaking, beach volleyball
results.why_it_is_special: Valencia's most emblematic beach — 1,300 m of golden sand with calm waters, a dedicated water-sports channel, and a lively promenade lined with restaurants. Blue Flag certified.

results.name: L'Albufera Natural Park
results.principal_activities: Boat rides on the lagoon, birdwatching, cycling, walking the dunes of El Saler, paella tasting in El Palmar
results.why_it_is_special: A freshwater lagoon and wetland just outside the city, with diverse ecosystems from marshlands to Mediterranean forest and unspoilt beaches. Birthplace of authentic Valencian paella; sunset boat rides are a highlight. Reachable by city bus (lines 24/25).

results.name: Sierra Calderona Natural Park
results.principal_activities: Hiking, mountain biking, birdwatching, visiting castle ruins
results.why_it_is_special: 18,019 hectares of Mediterranean habitat with ravines, pine and cork-oak forests, and panoramic views from El Garbí peak over the Gulf of Valencia. Five marked trails ranging from easy (1.5 km Blue Trail to El Garbí) to challenging full-day routes. Rich birdlife includes golden eagle, Bonelli's eagle, and griffon vulture.

results.name: Montanejos Hot Springs (Fuente de los Baños)
results.principal_activities: Swimming in natural thermal pools (25 °C year-round), hiking, visiting the Salto de la Novia waterfall
results.why_it_is_special: Natural warm springs with a history dating to 13th-century Arab baths, set in a scenic river gorge. Combine a dip with a hike to the nearby Novia waterfall for a full nature day. One of the most popular day trips from Valencia.

results.name: Bocairent & Covetes dels Moros + El Pou Clar
results.locality: Bocairent & Ontinyent, Vall d'Albaida (~90 min from Valencia)
results.principal_activities: Exploring cliff-carved window caves, swimming in natural pools at El Pou Clar, walking the medieval old town
results.why_it_is_special: Around 50 artificial "window caves" carved into a sheer cliff face — a mysterious archaeological site dating to roughly the 10th century. Combine with a refreshing swim at the crystal-clear natural pools of El Pou Clar in nearby Ontinyent.
